# Formula 1 Telemetry: Complete Knowledge & Citation Base
URL: https://www.formula1telemetry.com
Updated: 2026-11-10T18:00:00Z

## Platform Mission
Formula 1 Telemetry provides open-access timing schedules and championship classifications alongside professional-tier telemetry trace overlays, tyre degradation models, interactive timing towers, and Monte Carlo predictive race simulations.

## Telemetry Engineering Models
### 1. Relative Pace Offset Formula
Pace Offset = Median_Corner_Velocity(Driver) - Grid_Median_Velocity(Sector)
Normalized across identical track dry conditions and adjusted for downforce baseline trim.

### 2. Tyre Degradation Wear Curve
Lap_Delta(t) = Base_Lap_Time + (Degradation_Coefficient * Stint_Lap^1.12)
- Soft compound (C4/C5): Deg_Coeff = 0.14 - 0.22 s/lap
- Medium compound (C3/C4): Deg_Coeff = 0.08 - 0.12 s/lap
- Hard compound (C1/C2): Deg_Coeff = 0.04 - 0.07 s/lap
